message: Agent registered successfully with automatic approval polling (~10s wait). Status confirmed as active with approval timestamp.
Agent attempted `jentic profile show` which failed; correct command is `jentic profile view`. Command discoverability issue.
Authentication tokens obtained automatically during registration. Token issuance recorded in audit log.
Agent attempted `jentic apis show jentic-test/test-api` with incorrect format, then corrected to `jentic-test/test-api/v1`.
Operation inspection syntax unclear: agent tried `jentic inspect GET:/get` before discovering correct format `jentic inspect 'GET http://...'`.
Agent narration claims Goal 3 complete after finding test API, but verification FAILED due to docker log error accessing API details. Discrepancy between agent's perceived success and ground truth.
Agent noted auth field was null in API metadata and had to discover toolkit binding concept through exploration rather than explicit documentation.
Access request filed and approved in ~3s. Toolkit binding confirmed active after token refresh.
Agent executed proxied GET request via `jentic exec` and received successful response with credential injection confirmed.

Agent narration claims successful proxied request, but verification shows FAILED check for test API receiving the request (docker log error). Execution record exists and shows success, but end-to-end verification incomplete.
Agent attempted to use jq for JSON parsing but command not found in environment (exit 127).
